info.title: osucc
info.description: osu-cc launcher: builds the hook and plugins from a repo checkout, deploys them into the osu-cc data root and launches osu! with DOTNET_STARTUP_HOOKS. Installable as a dotnet tool (osucc status/deploy/run --no-build work without a checkout).

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: osu-cc launcher: build, deploy and run osu! with the startup hook (never touches the install dir).

options.name: --osu-dir
options.description: Path to the osu! install directory.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Path to the osu-cc repository root.

commands.name: build
commands.description: Build the hook and the plugins.

commands.name: deploy
commands.description: Deploy the hook and the plugin archives into the osu-cc data root.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Launch osu! with the already-deployed hook (no build or deploy).

commands.name: start
commands.description: Build, deploy the hook and plugins, then launch osu! with it.

commands.name: update
commands.description: Update the hook and plugins from NuGet/GitHub releases (add --launcher to also update osucc itself).

options.name: --launcher
options.description: Also update the osucc launcher itself. [default: False]

commands.name: clean
commands.description: Remove hook files from the osu install dir (legacy deployment) and the osu-cc data root.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show resolved paths and deployment state.
